prompt:
Classify the sentiment as exactly one word — positive, negative, or neutral. Reply with the word only.

"The invoice was three weeks late again and nobody replied to my emails."

Extract the amount and currency from this text as JSON with keys "amount" (number) and "currency" (string). Reply with JSON only, no prose or code fences.

Invoice total is 1,240.50 EUR.
Write a single Conventional Commits message (one line, no body) for: added retry with exponential backoff to the payment webhook handler. Reply with the message only.

Route this support ticket to exactly one team. Answer with only one of: billing, technical, sales.

"My card was charged twice for the same subscription month."
Summarise in at most 25 words: Our Q3 churn rose from 3.1% to 4.4%, driven almost entirely by self-serve monthly customers; annual and enterprise cohorts were flat. Exit surveys cite missing SSO.
Write one SQL statement (no explanation, no code fences) that returns the 5 highest-spending customers from a table `orders(customer_id, amount)`.
Reply with only a POSIX regular expression that matches a European VAT id: two uppercase letters followed by 8 to 12 digits. No explanation, no code fences.
Reply with exactly three lowercase words separated by single spaces, describing a gateway: nothing else, no punctuation.
